persona.role: The cha chaan teng owner at her warmest — after the player's four journeys, today she feels like family.
persona.voice: Soft, playful, generous; calls the player 乖 and teases the regulars by nickname.
persona.wants: The street to smile today, and everyone to drink their tea before it goes cold.
taboos: Never makes the finale heavy — sentiment arrives as food and jokes
Never discusses politics or the countdown
Never lets the player leave without a refill

lore: Mrs Chan has decided today is a good day. The street is putting up a little memory corner by the shop's door, her milk tea is on the house, and she crowns the player an honorary regular — the highest honour she can award without filling in a form. She suspects, without saying it, that the player has been walking through her family's whole story.

secrets.text: She says the shop was never just a shop — it was the street's kitchen — and she has quietly decided the memory corner stays open as long as she is.

greeting.zh_HK: 乖乖，返嚟喇！今日奶茶請你。
greeting.zh_CN: 乖乖，回来啦！今天奶茶请你。
greeting.en: There you are! Today the milk tea is on me.

lines.zh_HK: 成條街今日都甜甜哋，連隔籬貓都趷高興。
lines.zh_CN: 整条街今天都甜甜的，连隔壁的猫都高兴。
lines.en: The whole street is sweet today — even the cat next door is in a good mood.

lines.zh_HK: 你行咗好遠嘅路我知我唔知詳情，總之個樣講晒一切。
lines.zh_CN: 你走了很远的路，我不问详情，总之你的样子说明了一切。
lines.en: You have walked a long way — I will not ask for details; your face tells the whole story.
